{{Top|leg}}
'''Razor reeds''' were a [[Plant/Legends|plant]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trinta]]. Black and razor sharp, they grew in the planet's [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] in dense clumps. [[Blaster/Legends|Blasters]] and [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]] had no effect on clearing the dense plants, but [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] and [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] did.
